products.name: Continuous Compliance Monitoring & Audit-Evidence Automation (CIS/STIG on Intune + Entra) — Commercial
products.short_description: Monitor baseline drift and automate audit evidence for CIS/STIG on Intune + Entra endpoints — measure vs baseline, detect drift, and export POA&M-ready evidence — distinct from the one-time build. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Prove your endpoints stay compliant — not just on the day you deployed

Passing a CIS or STIG baseline once isn't the same as proving continuous compliance to an auditor months later. This solution gives you a repeatable way to monitor baseline drift and automate audit evidence for Intune + Entra endpoints in a federally regulated environment: measure current state against the baseline, detect drift, and export the evidence and POA&M-ready gaps auditors ask for — distinct from the one-time baseline build.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the continuous-compliance model (baseline → measure → detect drift → evidence/POA&M → remediate/track), how it complements a one-time CIS/STIG build, and where evidence comes from.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (an existing baseline, Intune/Entra roles + Graph read access, a reporting destination, evidence-retention needs, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to define the monitored control set, measure current vs baseline, schedule drift detection, and generate the audit-evidence and POA&M-ready gap exports, on a pilot then fleet-wide.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — control-state discovery, per-device baseline-conformance validation, an audit-evidence + drift/gap report (POA&M-ready), safe remediation of drifted settings (preview first), and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (control measured, drift detected, evidence exported), plus Best Practices for evidence retention and audit response.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Continuous, provable endpoint compliance — drift detected and audit evidence exported on demand — with a repeatable method and scripts you keep and reuse between audits.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CCAUDIT-Discovery.ps1 — inventory the control state of your CIS/STIG baseline on Intune + Entra (read-only)
    • CCAUDIT-Remediation.ps1 — safely re-apply drifted baseline settings (preview by default)
    • CCAUDIT-Report.ps1 — produce dated audit-evidence and a POA&M-ready gap export (read-only)
    • CCAUDIT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/populate the pilot or fleet target group (preview by default)
    • CCAUDIT-Validation.ps1 — measure per-device conformance of current state vs. the baseline (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
